row.team_price_text: $20 per block of 25,000 emails/mo (1-20 blocks), on top of a Mailchimp Standard or Premium plan
row.evidence: Mailchimp Transactional (Mandrill) is "available as an add-on to Mailchimp’s Standard and Premium plans" and is accessed "through your main Mailchimp login"; its docs and Transactional API document no SCIM endpoint and no user-management endpoints.
row.notes: New row. Mandrill is now sold as Mailchimp Transactional, a usage-priced add-on (blocks of 25,000 emails, $20/block at 1-20 blocks, cheaper per block at volume; dedicated IP $29.95/mo) that requires a Mailchimp Standard or Premium plan (Essentials is not eligible); billing is monthly. There are no per-user prices. Users are Mailchimp users: Transactional has no separate user directory or roles (Admins and Owners get full access, everyone else none), so provisioning follows the Mailchimp row (status none, no SCIM). SSO is Mailchimp's Enterprise SSO (OIDC, Premium only); sso_plan is inferred from the shared Mailchimp login and is not stated on a Transactional page. The Transactional API's /users/* calls only describe the API-connected account (info, ping, senders), so there is no user-management API. Okta's Mandrill app is SWA (password vaulting) only. No Entra, Google, OneLogin or JumpCloud Mandrill app was found.

plans.name: Transactional Email add-on (Mailchimp Standard or Premium required)
plans.price_text: $20/block of 25,000 emails (1 to 20 blocks); lower per-block rates at higher volumes; dedicated IP $29.95/month optional
plans.notes: Usage-priced. SSO depends on the underlying Mailchimp plan: Enterprise SSO is Premium-only.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented for Mailchimp Transactional or Mailchimp. Users are Mailchimp account logins; available stays null because no page says SCIM is not offered.

user_api.notes: The Transactional API (REST, POST calls with an API key) has a Users group, but it only returns information about the API-connected account (info, ping, ping2, senders). Multi-user access is handled with separate API keys, not user records.

endpoints.purpose: Information about the API-connected user (not user management)
List senders that have used the account

limitations.text: No role levels inside Transactional: Mailchimp Admins and Owners get full access, everyone else none.

okta.notes: OIN page markup marks only SWA as checked (last updated Aug. 27 2018).

fallbacks.notes: Mailchimp's SSO guide requires an Owner or Admin to invite each user before sign-in, so there is no JIT; Transactional uses the same Mailchimp login.
